LESSON: THE CONSTITUTION OF KENYA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Development and Governance
Topic 5.2: The Constitution of Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Constitution of Kenya. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The Constitution of Kenya
2. Practise The Constitution of Kenya at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Constitution of Kenya

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in The Constitution of Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in The Constitution of Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise The Constitution of Kenya at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise The Constitution of Kenya at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Constitution of Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to The Constitution of Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Constitution of Kenya using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Constitution of Kenya in the examples.
2. Explain The Constitution of Kenya to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Constitution of Kenya.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Constitution of Kenya using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Constitution of Kenya important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in The Constitution of Kenya
2. Practise The Constitution of Kenya at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Constitution of Kenya

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
